changelog:
Version 1.1.0

- Enhanced the Skill description and read-only promise language for additional security clarity and user guidance.
- Improved the "Read-Only Promise" section to specify that only resource signals and error logs are read, and recommended using read-only keys on public clouds.
- No new features or platform support added; all platform and connection instructions remain as before.
- Documentation update only; removed the redundant skill-card.md file for clarity.
- No impact to functionality or user workflow.
summary: A new ops model for the AI Agent era: an AI-Powered Intelligent Ops Assistant — an agent swarm that autonomously discovers issues and proactively repairs faults.
